content: The grace period is active <1>from {{fromDate}} to {{byDate}}</1> (days remaining: <2>{{delayDaysCount}}</2>). During this time, admins are not able to create new rooms or add new users. Once the grace period ends, the workspace will become unavailable until a new license is activated.

comment.text: Informational sub-description in the tariff title container that appears when a license grace period is active; includes HTML tags for formatting and placeholders for the start date, end date, and number of remaining days.
